profile.name: ER 88027 电流源
profile.description: ER 88027 是一台实验室电流源与电学测量设备，可输出设定电流，并读取实际电流和电阻值，适用于器件偏置、样品电阻表征及常规电学测试。
profile.description_en: The ER 88027 is a laboratory current source and electrical measurement instrument that can output a set current and read back current and resistance. It is used for device biasing, sample resistance characterization, and general electrical testing.
